name: Language Switcher
author: jesusarchive
description: macOS-style input source menu and switcher for the Omarchy bar, with Control-Space and Control-Option-Space.

barWidget.description: Shows the active keyboard layout as a macOS-style input source icon. Click for the Input menu; switch with Ctrl+Space (previous) and Ctrl+Alt+Space (next).

schema.label: Show input source name
schema.description: Show the layout name next to the icon in the bar.

schema.label: Show indicator on other switches
schema.description: The small badge shown after Ctrl+Alt+Space or a menu pick.
